notes.title: Epic Card Game Learn to Play with the Game Designer
notes.content: CJ Moynihan designed the latest set of expansions for Epic Card Game and will teach you how to play  Epic Card Game and answer questions in chat about game design and development and how to play.  Every card costs either 0 or 1 to play, so you can play your most powerful card on turn 1 (but so can your opponent!) There are no random packs or hard-to-get cards in the digital or the physical version of Epic Card Game. The digital Epic Card Game is completely free to play with all the cards.
